name: Polaris RZR 1000cc - 4 Seater
cardPhotoAlt: Polaris RZR 4-seater dune buggy parked at the Buggy Rents Dubai base
heroPhotoAlt: Polaris RZR four seater dune buggy parked on a red dune ridge in Dubai
blurb: One buggy for the whole family. Same chassis as the 2-seater with a second row behind.

durations.label: 30 minutes
durations.blurb: The lowest commitment. Enough to learn the controls and cross a few dune faces on the Polaris RZR 4-Seater.

durations.label: 1 hour
durations.blurb: The sweet spot for most riders. Time to settle into the Polaris RZR 4-Seater and get a proper run at the red dunes.

durations.label: 2 hours
durations.blurb: A longer route with more varied terrain and photo stops, for riders already comfortable on the Polaris RZR 4-Seater.
